extras.real_size: feather costume wings, approx. 130 cm wingspan and 70 cm tall, on a coat stand 145 cm tall
extras.notes: front faces -Y; fairy / bird style costume wings made of three overlapping feather rows (long lavender flight feathers, pink middle row, white coverts along the wing bow), each feather a soft cushion with a raised quill, on a cream felt back plate with a butter coloured centre cushion; two sky blue elastic shoulder straps on the back hang over the front peg of a honey wood coat stand; no religious symbols, no text, no logo

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
